تستغبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَغْبُوا (tastaḡbū) /tas.taɣ.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# تُسْتَغْبَوْا (tustaḡbaw) /tus.taɣ.baw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
